subject: ACE co-sell readiness & AWS listing — BrokerSys
messages:
From: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@brokersys.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@brokersys.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -04:00
Subject: ACE co-sell & AWS listing interest — quick intro

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking the time last week on the discovery call. BrokerSys is evaluating two vendors for our document automation layer; your latency/cost benchmarks looked promising and the team is keen to get Redwood listed in the AWS Marketplace and pursue the ACE co-sell path.

High-level asks from our side:
- What does ACE registration require from us (paperwork, point-of-contact, timeline)?
- Can you introduce your PDM/PSM so we can align on technical readiness and sales motion?
- What info do you need to create the Marketplace listing and co-sell opportunity pairing?

I've attached a short profile of our AWS footprint (BrokerSys-AWS-profile.xlsx) and a rough timeline: pilot in May, GA target late July. Our procurement and cloud teams will need the security/compliance checklist (SOC2 evidence) and an expected pricing band to model TCO.

Can we schedule a 30-min alignment early next week? Raj (cc'd) will be our technical lead.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Lee
Head of Product Partnerships
BrokerSys Inc.

Attachments: BrokerSys-AWS-profile.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>
To: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@brokersys.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACE co-sell & AWS listing interest — quick intro

Hi Hannah — great to hear, and thanks for the profile. Looping in Alex (PDM) and Marissa (PSM) so we can run technical and sales readiness in parallel.

Quick plan:
1) I'll open the ACE intake with AWS and request co-sell pairing. Expect an AWS ACE registration number within 72 hours once they confirm the intake.
2) Alex will run a 45-min technical readiness call to review architecture, expected QPS, and KV/cache behavior for your workloads.
3) Marissa will coordinate the mutual action plan and required procurement docs (SOC2, data flow diagrams).

I've attached an ACE readiness checklist for BrokerSys to pre-fill before the tech call. Can you confirm availability for a kickoff on Mon, Apr 5 between 9–11am PT? I can book a slot and include an internal pre-brief 15 minutes before.

Next steps for you: share the pilot success metrics (latency targets, expected concurrent requests) and any security controls that are showstoppers.

- Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.inference

--- Forwarded attachment: ACE-readiness-checklist.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.inference>
To: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@brokersys.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: PDM intro + agenda for technical readiness call

Hi Hannah / Raj — Alex here (PDM on this account). Thanks for including me.

Suggested agenda for our 45-min tech call:
- 5m introductions and success criteria for pilot
- 10m BrokerSys architecture and traffic profile (expected QPS, avg/peak sequence length)
- 10m security/compliance constraints (SOC2 controls, data residency)
- 10m demo of a sample inference flow and discussion of caching/kv needs
- 10m next steps and action items (ACE pairing, test account access)

Prep asks: please share an anonymized sample payload size and an estimate of concurrent user sessions during pilot. If you have an internal NFR doc, that helps. I've attached a short list of technical questions to speed the call.

I can take the call Tue Apr 6 10am PT or Wed Apr 7 9am PT — what works?

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Product Development Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: technical-questions.docx (DOCX, 9KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@brokersys.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: PSM note — mutual action plan and procurement items

Hi all — quick note from the PSM side.

I'll draft a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones aligned to your pilot/GA dates. Initial MAP items I'll include:
- Pilot kickoff (access + test keys)
- SOC2 artifact handover (we can provide certificate + scope summary)
- Pricing band and estimated token cost per 1k requests for pilot sizing
- ACE registration submission and AWS contact pairing
- Internal enablement (sales playbook + one-pager for BrokerSys sellers)

Requested from BrokerSys: CAL (contract acceptance lead) contact, procurement timeline, and any required MSAs or security addendum templates. If procurement prefers, we can initiate a simple form of MSA with limited exposure for pilot.

I'll sync with Soojin after the tech call and update the MAP in HubSpot.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Partner Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>
To: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@brokersys.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@brokersys.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: ACE co-sell & AWS listing interest — BrokerSys

Hannah / Raj — quick update following our internal syncs:

- I submitted the ACE intake with AWS this morning. AWS intake ID: ACE-REG-12345; intake portal: https://partners.aws.amazon.com/ace/registration/12345
- Alex will take the tech call Wed Apr 7 at 9am PT (calendar invite sent).
- Marissa started the MAP draft and will add procurement milestones to the HubSpot deal (link below).
- For Marketplace listing: we need a short product description (1–2 paragraphs) and two logos (SVG + PNG). If you can share those assets by EOD Thu Apr 8, we can push the listing draft to AWS marketplace console next week.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/BRK-2027-0042
Kickoff calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=soojin-brokersys-ace-kickoff

Next ask of you: confirm the procurement contact (CAL) and attach the pilot success metric doc in reply so Alex can review ahead of the call.

Appreciate the momentum — will update when AWS confirms pairing.

- Soojin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.inference

Attachments referenced: ACE-readiness-checklist.pdf
